companies.title: Companies
companies.subtitle: Onboard and manage the corporates that buy through Wrapzzo.
companies.emptyBody: Onboard your first corporate customer to get started.
companies.deactivateBody: The company and its users lose access to the platform until it is activated again.

detail.editSubtitle: Company details, logo, vendor roster and optional features.
detail.name: Company name
detail.logoHelp: PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG, up to 5 MB.
detail.logoHelpNew: Optional. Add it now, or after the company is created.
detail.logoFailedAfterCreate: Company created, but the logo failed to upload. Add it from the company page.
detail.logoDrop: Drop a logo here, or click to choose one
detail.vendorsHelp: Only gifts from checked vendors appear in this company's Gift Store.
detail.featuresHelp: Optional workflow changes, off by default. Nothing changes for the company until one is turned on.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Everyone with a Wrapzzo account at {{company}}.
users.subtitleNoName: Everyone with a Wrapzzo account at this company.
users.emptyBody: Add users one by one, or import a whole roster from a spreadsheet.
users.makeAdminBody: {{name}} will be able to manage users, roles and campaigns for {{company}}.
users.removeAdminBody: {{name}} will lose Company Admin access and go back to being a Member.
users.deleteBody: This permanently removes {{name}}'s account. It can't be undone.

addPage.title: Add users
addPage.subtitle: Add employees directly, one row per person.
addPage.help: Every column is required except Reports to email. For a deeper org hierarchy or a bigger batch, use the spreadsheet import instead.
addPage.serverErrors: Save failed. Fix these rows and try again:
addPage.none: Add at least one user before saving.

importPage.title: Import employees
importPage.subtitle: Bulk-add a roster from a spreadsheet.
importPage.intro: Use our template, or upload your own sheet and match its columns to ours. Every field is required except Reports to email.
importPage.review: Review the parsed rows below, then import.
importPage.drop: Drop an .xlsx roster here, or click to choose one
importPage.mapTitle: Match the columns of {{file}} to our fields
importPage.mapHelp: This sheet doesn't use our template's column names.
importPage.noHeader: This sheet has no header row to read. Download the template to check the expected layout.
importPage.serverErrors: Import validation failed. Fix these rows in the sheet and upload it again:

vendors.title: Vendors
vendors.subtitle: The fulfilment partners who produce and deliver gifts.
vendors.emptyBody: Onboard your first fulfilment partner to get started.
vendors.suspendBody: The vendor can no longer sign in, and no new orders are routed to them, until reactivated.

drawer.newDescription: They get an email with a link to set their own password. No password is set here.
drawer.name: Vendor name
drawer.emailLocked: The sign-in email can't be changed.

gifts.title: Gift Store
gifts.subtitle: The catalogue every company's Gift Store and campaigns draw from.
gifts.emptyBody: Add the first gift to the catalogue.
gifts.outTitle: Mark this gift out of stock?
gifts.outBody: It disappears from every Gift Store and can't be added to new campaigns until it is back in stock.

detail.newSubtitle: Add a gift to the catalogue.
detail.editSubtitle: Details, pricing and the image shown in the Gift Store.
detail.vendorOwned: Submitted by {{vendor}}. You can change whether it is in stock, but not its content.
detail.name: Gift name
detail.photoRequiredHelp: An order for this gift needs a photo of the recipient, or their email so they can upload one.
detail.artworkRequiredHelp: Personalised items such as prescription pads: the vendor can't dispatch until the orderer approves a proof.
detail.imageHelp: One image, shown in the Gift Store.
detail.imageHelpNew: Optional. Add it now, or after the gift is created.
detail.imageDrop: Drop an image here, or click to choose one
detail.imageFailedAfterCreate: Gift created, but the image failed to upload. Add it from the gift page.

access.title: Access Control
access.subtitle: Pick a company and a designation, then grant the keys everyone with that designation gets.
access.noDesignations: This company has no users with a designation yet.
access.pickBoth: Choose a company and a designation to see what it can do.
